thesis: Pre-open headlines for 2026-09-08 highlight ongoing macro crosscurrents ('Dow futures drop as Iran war, Canada tariffs hit Wall Street', crypto sliding on US-Iran fighting) alongside corporate developments (Oracle earnings warnings and falling stock, Mistral AI Series D, Novartis pipeline setbacks, Chevron/GeoPark Venezuela oil headlines). While geopolitical and trade risks remain elevated, our balanced portfolio is already well-structured across core equity index (VTI), fixed-income ballast (BND), and growth/semiconductor exposure (NVDA, XLK). Holding 4 positions (cap 6), keeping all single names well below the 35% cap (VTI ~28%, NVDA ~18%), and retaining our $35.00 cash reserve (~32% of equity vs the 15% floor) maintains prudent defense and flexibility without forcing turnover on noisy pre-market headlines.
